mechanism: Selegiline (selective MAO-B inhibitor) combined with chlorpromazine (antipsychotic with alpha-adrenergic and dopamine antagonism) increases risk of hypertensive crisis, serotonergic toxicity, and severe CNS depression through additive monoaminergic effects and CYP450 interactions.
action: Avoid this combination if possible; if co-administration is necessary, use selegiline at lowest dose (≤5mg daily), monitor blood pressure closely, and educate patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms.
